# Fixture job pages

Fictional pages for `job-page-text.test.ts` and the fetcher tests (ADR-0008 §6). Every company, person, id
and text here is invented; no page was copied from a real site. The structure only imitates the markup of
each kind of site (LinkedIn public job view, Gupy, Greenhouse, Lever) closely enough to exercise the
extractor. `injection.html` is an adversarial item for the T-058 corpus: its instructions must reach the
model only as delimited data.
